title: On the Ulrichness of twisted syzygies and dual syzygies bundles
summary: Given a projective variety $X$ and a very ample line bundle $\mathcal{L}$ on $X$, we classify for which $X$ and $\mathcal{L}$ the twisted syzygies and twisted dual syzygies bundles are Ulrich with respect to the polarizations $\mathcal{L}^a$. We obtain some partial results when considering an arbitrary polarization $H$.
